messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate observed from gateway-prod across multiple regions. Error spike started ~10m ago. Service: /v1/generate. P50 latency up. Paging on-call.
Sara: on it. grabbing logs now — which cluster is hit most?
Miguel: us-west-2 primarily, but some spillover to eu-west as retries kick in.
John: seeing a big increase in backend 502/504 from model-proxy. Sample log lines are empty for many requests.
Aisha: opening a debug session. quick check — traces show very few spans for the failing requests, sampling looks like 0.5%? that can't be right.
Ben: I think we recently pushed a sampling config change in telemetry-service, pr #412. Could be related.
Sara: timeline: deploy at 09:12, first anomalies ~09:18, pagination of errors ramped by 09:25. Rolling back the telemetry change might be low-risk but will remove detailed traces.
DevOps-Bot: pagerduty notification sent to @oncall and @sre-nightshift.
Miguel: customers reporting: 3 enterprise customers on dedicated capacity seeing 10-15% error rates. UX teams report increased retries in mobile apps.
Sara: quick mitigation suggestion: 1) increase sampling to 100% for requests to /v1/generate for the next 30m, 2) enable request-id propagation for model-proxy, 3) roll back telemetry config if we confirm correlation.
Emmie: I can flip sampling to 100% via staging config in telemetry-service. Pushing change now: `kubectl set env deployment/telemetry-service TRACE_SAMPLING=1.0 -n infra` — will take ~15s to apply.
John: while Emmie does that, can someone tail the proxy logs and grep for missing request-id? `kubectl logs -l app=model-proxy -c proxy -n prod --since=5m | grep request-id || true`
Aisha: grep shows ~60% of failing lines have empty request-id header.
Miguel: that explains traces dropping. If request-id not propagated upstream, traces won't stitch and logs look sparse.
Ben: checking PR history — we changed the header name in a refactor (x-request-id -> x-rw-request-id) and telemetry-service sampling config assumed old header. Oops.
Sara: pragmatic plan: 1) patch proxy to forward both headers (old + new) as stopgap, 2) enable full sampling so we get spans where request-id exists, 3) craft a follow-up to standardize header names.
John: I can ship a hotfix to proxy: small lua filter to copy header if missing. Code:
```
-- proxy-header-copy.lua
local req = ngx.req.get_headers()
if not req["x-rw-request-id"] and req["x-request-id"] then
  ngx.req.set_header("x-rw-request-id", req["x-request-id"])
end
```
Deploying to canary now.
DevOps-Bot: Canary deploy started for model-proxy/*hotfix* on canary-3.
Emmie: sampling set to 100% across prod. Confirming traces are now appearing for successful requests.
Miguel: after canary, 502s dropped ~70% on canary nodes.
Sara: good. roll canary to remaining nodes, keep 10% capacity as buffer.
John: rolling canary to 50% now: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/model-proxy -n prod --record`
Aisha: adding incident ticket: https://tickets.redwood.ai/INC-2026-451 with initial notes and impacted customers list. Setting severity to P2 for now (customer impact but mitigated).
Ben: we should also add a temporary log enrichment to include `trace_id` and `request_id` in proxy error logs to make postmortem easier.
Sara: agreed. add `trace_id` and `x-rw-request-id` to logs. small config change in logging-agent: `env LOG_EXTRA_FIELDS=trace_id,request_id`
Miguel: Verified customer-facing SLA page: no large-scale downtime, but API error rate increased for some tenants. CS notified.
Emmie: CS update sent: "We're investigating increased API errors; mitigation underway. Will follow up in 30m." :email:
DevOps-Bot: telemetry sampling rollback note: DO NOT rollback sampling to <1% until we confirm logs/traces are stable. We need observability to finish triage.
John: all proxy pods now on hotfix. 5xxs down to baseline in both us-west and eu-west. Latency back to normal for 90th.
Sara: next actions: - keep sampling at 100% for 1h and collect datasets - schedule postmortem to investigate header refactor and improve CI checks - implement canonical header propagation in model-proxy (no more dual headers) - add a runbook step for "verify request-id propagation" in deploy checklist.
Aisha: I'll own the postmortem doc and runbook updates. Adding timeline and evidence links.
Ben: tagging addtl follow-up: metric alert tuning so small telemetry changes don't trigger large pages without customer impact signal.
Miguel: prep note for next handoff: if errors reappear, check request-id presence, trace sampling, and recent PRs to telemetry/config.
Sara: handing off to night on-call @sre-nightshift. brief: hotfix deployed, sampling at 100%, logs enriched, 5xxs stabilized, ticket INC-2026-451 open, watch for regressions. ping me if anything spikes.
Emmie: lowering sampling back to 10% at T+1h after we upload trace dump. I'll coordinate with Aisha on traces export.
John: marking this thread as resolved for now — will update ticket with mitigation steps and timeline. :white_check_mark:
oncall-bot: Incident note appended to INC-2026-451. Duration: ~45m. Tags: observability, proxy, stopgap-instrumentation, paging.
